description.text: Reads space usage for each supported local filesystem and compares it with warning and critical thresholds. Writable filesystems determine attention; mounts that share capacity are identified. It does not check inodes, quotas or network filesystems.

warning_help.text: Warn at or above this percentage of used space.

critical_help.text: Mark critical at or above this percentage of used space.

execution_mismatch.text: Execution evidence did not match the recipe.

execution_failed.text: The observation command failed or exited unexpectedly.

execution_timed_out.text: The observation exceeded its time budget.

execution_policy_rejected.text: The agent rejected execution under its local policy.

execution_spawn_failed.text: The approved observation tool could not be started.

runner_busy.text: The agent is finishing another observation.

output_unsupported.text: Command output could not be interpreted reliably.

clock_uncertain.text: The observation clock could not be verified.

boot_uncertain.text: The boot identity changed or could not be verified during observation.

package_changes.text: The cached package plan contains upgrades, new dependencies or held-back packages.

package_removals.text: The cached package plan includes removals that need attention.

package_cache_unverified.text: The cached plan contains no changes; repository freshness and local-state consistency remain unverified.

reboot_marker_present.text: A package has left a reboot-required marker.

reboot_assurance_unverified.text: No reboot marker was observed; other reboot needs remain unverified.

fstrim_unit_unavailable.text: The fstrim timer or service is unavailable.

fstrim_timer_disabled.text: The fstrim timer is disabled or masked.

fstrim_timer_failed.text: The fstrim timer is in a failed state.

fstrim_condition_skipped.text: A systemd condition skipped the timer or service.

fstrim_history_unavailable.text: No completed fstrim service history is available.

fstrim_running.text: The timer or service is still running or changing state.

fstrim_service_failed.text: The fstrim service reports a failed run.

fstrim_schedule_unverified.text: The next fstrim schedule could not be verified.

fstrim_condition_unverified.text: Evaluated systemd condition history is unavailable.

fstrim_trigger_unconfirmed.text: The latest timer trigger has no confirmed completed service run.

fstrim_observed_success.text: The timer is scheduled and a completed fstrim service reported success; reclaimed space is unverified.

unsupported_observation.text: The observation format or evaluator is unsupported.

package_plan_clear.text: No changes in the local package plan. Cached metadata may be outdated; security updates are not independently verified.

reboot_marker_absent.text: No package reboot marker observed. Running software may still need a reboot.

fstrim_context_unavailable.text: Saved trim execution or schedule evidence could not be verified.

fstrim_awaiting_result.text: Awaiting the scheduled trim result; an earlier success does not confirm this run.

fstrim_result_overdue.text: The scheduled trim result is overdue by at least 24 hours; successful completion has not been confirmed.

skill_disabled.text: Monitoring is disabled globally. Settings and past readings are kept.

enablement_changed.text: Waiting for a new reading after the skill was enabled.

no_assignment.text: No current assignment has been delivered.

baseline_recovery_required.text: Baseline delivery requires credential replacement after a recovery conflict.

contact_unavailable.text: Current agent contact is unavailable. The last observation is historical.

server_clock_uncertain.text: The control-plane clock is inconsistent with retained evidence.

assignment_obsolete.text: Settings changed. A new assignment and observation are needed.

missing_capability.text: The agent does not support the connected observation worker.

no_observation.text: Waiting for the first observation of this assignment.

agent_clock_uncertain.text: Agent timestamps are too far ahead of first receipt.

history_expired.text: The latest observation is older than the 90-day history window.

invalid_thresholds.text: The critical threshold must be greater than the warning threshold.

disk_usage.text: The fullest writable filesystem is {path}, at {percent}% used.

disk_empty.text: No usable writable local filesystem capacity was observed.

disk_incomplete.text: The local filesystem observation is incomplete.

package_output_unavailable.text: A complete local package simulation could not be verified.

usage.1.text: Set warning and critical thresholds. They apply to supported local filesystems on servers using the defaults.

usage.2.text: Open a server from Servers to override its thresholds or observation interval.

notify.disk.warning.text: Filesystem {mount} is {used}% full, at or above its {threshold}% warning threshold.

notify.disk.critical.text: Filesystem {mount} is {used}% full, at or above its {threshold}% critical threshold.

notify.disk.resolved.text: All monitored writable filesystems are below their warning thresholds. The fullest is {mount}, at {used}% used.

collection_issues_title.text: Filesystems that could not be checked

collection_mount_inaccessible.text: Could not access this filesystem or read its space usage.

collection_mount_unverifiable.text: Could not verify this filesystem or read reliable space usage.

collection_unsupported_type.text: This filesystem type is not supported by this skill.

collection_capacity_unavailable.text: Could not read reliable space usage.

collection_inventory_unavailable.text: Could not read the server’s filesystem list.

collection_inventory_malformed.text: The server’s filesystem list could not be read reliably.

collection_inventory_overflow.text: The filesystem list exceeded the check’s limit. Some filesystems could not be checked.

collection_records_overflow.text: The filesystem list exceeded the check’s limit. Some filesystems could not be checked.

collection_topology_changed.text: The filesystem list changed during this check. The reading may be incomplete.

collection_incomplete.text: Not all filesystems could be checked. Available readings are shown above.

collection_no_filesystems.text: No writable local filesystem readings are available.
